title: The four-dimensional normalized-volume gap
exact_target: At a singular point of a normal complex algebraic fourfold with zero boundary and Q-Cartier canonical divisor that is klt nearby, must normalized volume be at most 162, with equality exactly for the analytic ordinary quadratic double point in $C^{5}$?
